beats.say: Beyoncé's Crazy in Love hit number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in May 2003.
Dangerously in Love debuted atop the Billboard 200 with 317,000 first week sales.
She sang the Star Spangled Banner at Super Bowl XXXVIII on 1 February 2004.
Three milestones in twelve months turned a solo debut into a global takeover.
The album has sold more than 11 million copies worldwide.

meta.summary: Beyoncé's debut solo single Crazy in Love topped the Billboard Hot 100 in May 2003, followed by a number one album and a Super Bowl national anthem performance within twelve months.
meta.comment: Which Beyoncé milestone from 2003 to 2004 surprised you most?
facts: Crazy in Love became Beyoncé's first number-one single as a solo artist on the US Billboard Hot 100 in May 2003.
Dangerously in Love debuted at number one on the Billboard 200, selling 317,000 copies in its first week.
Beyoncé performed The Star-Spangled Banner at Super Bowl XXXVIII on 1 February 2004.
Dangerously in Love has sold more than 11 million copies globally.
